name: Whiteboard: ink strokes on a board that travels
for: teaching a process step by step; the drawing finishes on the spoken word

motion.ease: strokes go slow, fast, slow, timed so each ends on the spoken word
motion.note: titles 11 to 18% of the height, labels 3 to 6.5%; ghosts of the next step at 5 to 10% ink; bottom 12% clear for subtitles

camera: travels across one large board; no cuts
source: colour roles and size ranges after lemo-opuscar's whiteboard notes (MIT); surface and the typeface choice are ours
